scope: Complete compare_artifacts CPU byte-selection entry for a unique localized single-line change; exact packet equivalence on broad cases; no token-counter, model, cash, GPU, or end-to-end claim.

implementation.procedure: Inspect the public entry and guard proof, including the token-counter exclusion.
implementation.acceptance: Only a single inserted/deleted line absent from the opposite text can skip matching; all other paths retain the original matcher.

reference_boundary.procedure: Compare frozen baseline and candidate packets over empty, CRLF, Unicode, repeated, bound and randomized cases.
reference_boundary.acceptance: All 6,032 complete-entry packets are byte-for-byte equal and restore exactly.

data_integrity.procedure: Check baseline/code/input hashes, fixed seed, case count and seven samples.
data_integrity.acceptance: No missing cases or samples and all recorded hashes match.

numerical_sanity.procedure: Recompute medians and reduction from finite nonnegative millisecond samples.
numerical_sanity.acceptance: Reported values match raw samples and units.

measurement_validity.procedure: Run seven alternating-order paired complete-entry calls after warmup.
measurement_validity.acceptance: Candidate median is at most half baseline without changing packets.

reproducibility.procedure: Rerun the frozen measurement and focused artifact tests in a separate process.
reproducibility.acceptance: Assertions and focused tests pass on the recorded CPU environment.
